chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Joel gu mar gu Petuel.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' kɨklhi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' dhi' gu tanoolh tattat.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jugi gu ñi'ook jix jugi; gio ba' jix jugi ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' bɨx suudai' u'va kuiñcha na gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu chin.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' jix kavɨk cham jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; gio ba' taatam maavɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam iigɨx; gio ba' bɨx; mi' dhɨr mamraga'n chooto.
Jano' ba' jix xuaak tu' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.
Jano' ba' yooxi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; na gu' tiriik ka't bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uubas tiriik kai' vaas; na gu' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam iigɨx gio gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; gio ba' bɨx gu u'u yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨmɨim; gio ba' daraa bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios duuñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na gu' mia'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham na ja'p chajaañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan.
Jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jugi vupui bhaan gu vupui bhai' ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kai'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n jix bɨɨx duu ulhña'; na gu' jix duñia' tiriik.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax na gu' cham chooto'n gio jix bɨɨx duu kakneer.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duuñ; na gu' gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki mɨmɨim bɨx gu u'u yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax yooxi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio tu'; na gu' gu suudai' gu tai oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu Sioon jix bhaan gu kavɨk; gio ba' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; na gu' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios na gu' mia'n.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tukgam gu tanoolh toov ɨkgiga'n bhaan gu kakkavɨk biiñ na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't nɨidhim tu' mi' dhɨr ka't mɨɨjidha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai bhaan mɨmɨim; gio ba' na ja'p u'uu pai' gu Edeen ka't gu oidha' vupui bhaan na ja'p oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kavaayo; gio ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam kavaayo jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' na ja'p mɨmɨim gu tai jajar na ja'p jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam na ba'.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bɨx.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kavɨk jix duñia' na ja'p gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix tɨ'ɨ vaak jodai; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duiñchu' maa'n; gio ba' bhaan gu kuchii cham xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu ñi'ook vaak jodai jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak jɨjɨkgɨm gu ñi'ook ɨ'xkum.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu tas gu masad gu si'avag.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' mui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix gɨ' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' chɨkka.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jano' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx suanda' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ cham jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu ñi'ook na ba' daak jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch sɨlhka'n.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook kiicha' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu Sioon mɨmɨim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu masad kɨklhi'ñga'n a'aalh; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ba'k jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam cham gu maa'nkar na ba' chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix duñia' a'ga tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oidha' uañi'ñka' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' jootsa' gu takarui' bɨ'ñdhatu' boopoya'; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' jix gaki oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' gu vupui ka't bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai'; na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ na gu' jix duu tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham jum i'obh; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' duñia' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax yooxi' cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki na gu' gu u'u gu i'bhɨ iigɨx gu i'bhɨ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gio gu ma'nkam gu Sioon gu ñi'ook gu taat gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhuuk jix dhaav bhaan gu ñi'ook dhuuk gu tanoolh na jix bhai' na ja'p gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tiriik gu Jawatan suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jugi gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jugi bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨ'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' ka't gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel dhi' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bhaan bɨx gu chuukug gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' kɨklhi'ñga'n tɨɨtki' biipibop.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio bhaan tu duukam bhaan ja'tkam na tu juan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr gu tai kuubh.
Jano' ba' gu tas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam gu masad gu ɨ'ɨr va'k gu tanoolh jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'; na gu' gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu Jerusalem u'ua'tɨdham na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨgim.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp gu Josapat ba'k ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx kuiñcha gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mamai'chɨk bhaan gu ja'tkam a'aalh jix maa ganai' suudai' u'va na ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ñ tu' bɨɨx gu Tiro gu Sidoon bɨx gu Palestina gu Kuereeis tu' xoi'kam tu' bhaan mo'o.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' baabuk jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu'x a'bhar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Griegos.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' pai' bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' bi'iix gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sabeos gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Pregonad dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix kavɨk bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uux u'u kavɨk; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr jix kavɨk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chɨbɨɨp bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Josapat; na gu' na ba' bɨx chɨbɨɨp xikoolh.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' tu'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix bhuup; na gu' tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Mukos gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' mia'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tas gu masad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu si'avag.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu Sioon maa'n gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Jerusalem gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't nɨɨra gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't gu Jerusalem abhaar cham.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bii'm bɨx gu Judaa gu suudai'; gio ba' suudai' buusñi gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Sittim.
Jano' ba' gu Ejipto ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom ka't gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; na gu' gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr.
Gu' gu' gu Judaa na ba' bɨɨx tas ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ɨ'ɨr cham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Sioon.
